description: §19.4.3 `!{}` handler SUCCESS passthrough: loadItem('ok') returns the id (no fail), no arm fires, the success value flows to `result`, and the handler lifts it to Phase.Loaded(result). Proves `!{}` catches ONLY error variants; the success value passes through unwrapped.
rationale: Success passthrough: loadItem('ok') returns the id (no fail), so no `!{}` arm fires and the success value flows to `result`; the handler then lifts it to Phase.Loaded(result). Proves the `!{}` handler catches ONLY error variants and passes the success value through. S478 (bootstrap triage C12): `Phase` has payload variants, and §14.13.2 refuses one in a text sink — "**Refused:** a struct, a tape, a tuple, a map or set, a payload enum value, … In markup text, a quoted attribute or a logic template this SHALL be compile error **`E-TEXT-NON-PRIMITIVE`**". `#out` now renders `label(@phase)`, a `string`; the state assertion is unchanged.
